It looks like this overlaps with Ratan's 82349 ("spdmd: Add test framework and build options," PS19, Chinmay CR+1) which proposes a different framework foundation -- I don't think the two CLs cross-reference each other and the surface they touch is mostly the same set of meson plumbing files.

Differences I noticed walking the two side by side: 82349 uses meson_options.txt, names the wrap gtest.wrap, places tests under tests/ rather than test/, pulls in gmock in addition to gtest, and adds a valgrind test setup via add_test_setup; 89647 has none of those (yet).  82349 also modifies requester/spdm_discovery.hpp to add a friend declaration for SPDMDiscovery_TestPeer so tests can reach private members, which 89647 does not do and probably should not do.  82349 has 261 lines of actual test content (mock transport satisfying the DiscoveryType concept, fixtures, real assertions on registered responders) which 89647 does not have yet.

If the path forward is to land 89647 first as the framework foundation and then have 82349's test content move on top, a few things probably want explicit discussion before either lands: whether the friend-for-test pattern in spdm_discovery.hpp is acceptable or should be replaced (a public iterator was added in 82349 specifically to support this); whether gmock is in scope for the framework now or later; and whether the valgrind add_test_setup is wanted from day one (it has been useful in similar daemons for catching libspdm-side leaks under concurrent discovery).

I don't think this needs to block 89647 from landing -- the framework decision is clearly yours as owner -- but cross-linking the two CLs and giving Ratan a chance to weigh in before the framework gets cemented seems healthy, given the work already invested on 82349 and the existing CR+1 there.
~

Thanks.  This was mostly something I was hacking on a few months ago and haven't made tons of progress on.  That's why I marked it as WIP.

I'll also take a look at Ratan's change when I get a chance.
